goal: Raised-block terrain, where v13 failed the IoU gate.
dropped: 4002: too dark to label reliably with superpixels; not used
selection: 17 candidate sols (>=~50 sols from every earlier scene) were downloaded and viewed as plain thumbnails only. Block-rich scenes chosen for training; test_v7 deliberately mixes a large raised outcrop (4300), a plate field (2199) and a broad flat bright slab that must stay ground (2950). No model prediction was viewed on any of them before this file.
method: Same as v6: SLIC superpixels classified by eye plus traced polygons for rocks smaller than a superpixel.
